subject: EdgeCraft renewal: performance comparison and capacity proposal
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@edgecraft.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion + recent performance concerns

Hi Karthik,

Quick note as we're coming up on our annual renewal: we've been running some internal throughput/latency comparisons against a vendor called FastServe and seeing better p95/p99 on some of our burst workloads. That, combined with a price quote they sent, has put this renewal on our procurement team's radar.

Before we go down that road, we'd like to run a short bakeoff with Redwood focused on: 1) p99 tail latency for 1–3k concurrent requests, 2) cost per 1M tokens at our observed distribution, and 3) short-term capacity increases for our holiday burst.

Can you propose a plan and a timeline? If Redwood can show comparable tail latency and ~15–20% lower TCO, we'll prioritize staying. Otherwise procurement may push a formal RFP.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Infrastructure
EdgeCraft, Inc.
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam@edgecraft.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + recent performance concerns

Sam — thanks for the heads up and the clear asks. We can run a focused bakeoff that mirrors your traffic shape and provide a side-by-side cost model.

Proposal (short):
- 48-hour benchmark window under your test harness (we'll provide a small runner and runbooks)
- Match your p99 target and report p50/p90/p95/p99 and cost per 1M tokens
- Dedicated 8-GPU pool for the test to mirror holiday burst; optional 2-week canary after agreement

Marissa (CC) will own success criteria and scheduling; Rishi will map the infra profile and telemetry hooks. I'll send a short SOW and a proposal once we align on dates.

Available times for a 30m kickoff: today 3pm PT or tomorrow 10am PT. Which works?

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeCraft bakeoff — draft runbook and options

Folks — draft plan below for the kickoff with EdgeCraft. I summarized options so we can quickly agree what to commit to: 

1) Bakeoff scope (48h):
   - Workload: replay of representative traces (30m warmup + 48h steady + controlled spikes)
   - Metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency, token cost, GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate

2) Capacity/term options to offer post-bakeoff (pick one to offer to customer):
   A) Standard renewal: 12-month term, standard pricing
   B) Growth uplift: 12-month term + 25% dedicated GPU pool increase for first 3 months, 8% list price discount
   C) Strategic retention: 12-month term + 40% dedicated pool increase for 6 months, 10% discount + 1-month free burst credits (6-figure credit to be approved)

3) Deliverables: bench results spreadsheet, single-slide executive summary, SOW draft, runbook/logs tarball

Attachments: runbook_template.md (internal), cost_model_template.csv (internal)

Rishi — can you confirm the GPU spec (A100x80/4 or H100x80/4?) and whether we can isolate a dedicated pool in us-west for the test on 7/3–7/4? Ben — this likely needs a fast-track concession approval for option C.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam@edgecraft.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: EdgeCraft Ops <ops@edgecraft.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + recent performance concerns

Thanks Karthik/Marissa — we ran a short verification against a subset of traffic and attached the results (edgecraft_bakeoff_results.xlsx). Key notes from our side:
- FastServe managed to shave ~18% from our current provider on token TCO and improved p99 by ~30ms under 3k concurrent requests.
- We didn’t run Redwood through a full replay yet — we can do that if you can commit to the dedicated pool and the telemetry hooks you mentioned.

If Redwood can match or beat FastServe on p99 and show a realistic TCO within ~15%, we can avoid a full procurement RFP. Right now procurement has an internal deadline: decision path locked by 2028-07-12.

Attachments: edgecraft_bakeoff_results.xlsx (60KB)

Sam
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-02T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: EdgeCraft bakeoff results and recommended save plan (for approval)

Team — summary of customer data and ask:
- Customer: EdgeCraft (DC-4321). They ran a competitor check; their quick run shows FastServe ahead on TCO (~18%) and slightly better p99 in burst. They will start procurement if we don’t present a credible plan. Decision deadline 2028-07-12.

Recommended save plan (what to offer to Sam):
1) Execute the 48h bakeoff in their harness on us-west dedicated H100 pool (we can provision 8 H100s) — dates: 2028-07-03 to 2028-07-05.
2) Commercial: Strategic retention package (Option C) with these concessions: 10% list discount for 12 months, 40% dedicated pool uplift for first 6 months, and 1 month free burst credits (applied to first invoice).
3) Contingency: If post-bakeoff metrics still lag p99 by >20% or TCO delta >15%, offer a staged migration assistance package and an extended pilot credit to soften churn.

Approvals needed: Ben (sales leader) sign-off on the 10% discount + credit (estimated revenue impact ~US$120k in year 1). Rishi — confirm infra availability for the dates and a plan for telemetry integration. Marissa — own SLA/KPIs and Exec-1 pager for Sam.

I recommend we send the proposal and SOW to Sam by EOD 7/02 so they have time to review before their internal procurement meetings next week.

— Karthik
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sam Patel <sam@edgecraft.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-02T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal & SOW: EdgeCraft bakeoff + retention package

Hi Sam — thanks again for sharing your initial results and timeline. Attached is a short SOW and a proposed retention package that reflects what we discussed internally. High level:

- 48-hour bakeoff on a dedicated 8x H100 pool in us-west (2028-07-03 to 2028-07-05)
- Deliverables: bench spreadsheet, exec-1 pager, runbook and logs, and a cost comparison model
- Commercial offer: 12-month Strategic retention package — 10% list discount, 40% dedicated pool uplift for first 6 months, and 1 month of burst credits applied to the first invoice

Attachments: proposal_redwood_sow_v3.docx, bench-run-logs.tar.gz

Next steps: please confirm you approve the 7/3 start window and that we can access your replay harness (SFTP endpoint + sample traces) by 12pm PT 7/02 so Rishi can finalize the runbook. If that works, we’ll start provisioning the pool immediately and share the runbook + telemetry hooks.

If you’d like, we can have a quick 15m call tomorrow at 9am PT to walk through the SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping EdgeCraft on Redwood.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposal_redwood_sow_v3.docx (42KB), bench-run-logs.tar.gz (2.4MB)
